Multimedia University (MMU)
Faculty of Computing and Informatics
TMA1301 Computational Methods - Mini Project Brief

Instructions:
1. This is a group assignment. Each group should have 3 to 5 members.
2. All work must be your own. Plagiarism will result in zero marks.
3. Submit your files through MMU eBwise before the deadline.

Project Tasks
Your group is required to complete the following:
a) Conduct a literature review on numerical methods for solving non-linear equations.
b) Implement the bisection, Newton-Raphson and secant methods in Python.
   i. Each method must print the number of iterations.
   ii. Use a tolerance of 1e-6.
c) Compare the accuracy and speed of the three methods using at least five test functions.
d) Write a technical report of 2,000 to 2,500 words.
e) Prepare a 10-minute presentation with slides.
f) Keep minutes of every group meeting.

Assessment
Your mini project will be assessed on correctness, the clarity of the report and the quality of the presentation.
